_about: Reviewer spec for ju26-issue-2283 (B5, human-curated). Every behavior change cites ledger tests and the verdict it expects; the record builder checks it against the ledger. BC-2 is backed by a counterfactual run (PR head with only the global filter reverted), recorded in out/2283/counterfactual/ by scripts/verify_2283_base.sh.
blind_intent: Requirement #2283: the generator (CS8785) and analyzer (AD0001) must stop crashing when a [MessagePackObject] member's type is a closed generic value type from a referenced assembly. A fix should keep reporting every real problem it reported before, just without the crash.

behavior_changes.title: No more analyzer/generator crash on closed generic value types from a referenced assembly
behavior_changes.link_why: Exactly what #2283 asks for: AD0001 IndexOutOfRangeException on base, clean on head.

question.prompt: After this PR, what happens when App builds?

options.text: Builds clean; the resolver is generated
AD0001: the MessagePack analyzer throws IndexOutOfRangeException
MsgPack003: MyGenericStruct<int> must be a MessagePackObject

question.reveal_text: Base: AD0001 (IndexOutOfRangeException in TypeCollector) and the resolver is silently not generated. Head: no diagnostics, resolver generated.

behavior_changes.title: MsgPack004 errors about a referenced generic type's unkeyed member are now silently dropped (global filter, not requested)
behavior_changes.link_why: #2283 asks to stop a crash. The PR also wraps TypeCollector's diagnostic callback so EVERY diagnostic located outside this compilation is dropped. Counterfactual: the PR head with only that filter reverted reports MsgPack004 (error) for Box<int>.Unkeyed and does not crash; the filter alone removes it. The agent's own UnkeyedMember test asserts the silence.

question.prompt: After this PR, what does the developer of App see when building?
question.reveal_text: Base: MsgPack004 error for Box<int>.Unkeyed, then AD0001 crash. Head: no diagnostics at all. Head with only the global filter reverted: MsgPack004 errors, no crash. The crash fix keeps the error; the unrequested filter deletes it.

refusals.topic: Should App be told about problems in a referenced generic type whose formatter App generates?
refusals.why: The PR's comment says such problems 'are reported by the compilation that defines them'. That holds only if Lib ran the MessagePack analyzer, and the formatter for Box<int> is generated in App, not Lib. Reporting policy across assemblies is a maintainer call; the evidence shows the PR changed it without being asked.

refusals.topic: Should the global filter be split out of this fix?
refusals.why: The crash fix (FirstOrDefault + GetPropertyIdentifierLocation) stands on its own: the counterfactual run has no crash. The filter is a separate behavior change that needs its own requirement.

story_claims.quote: Their problems are reported by the compilation that defines them, so they are dropped here
story_claims.claim: Dropping these diagnostics loses nothing, because the defining assembly reports them.
story_claims.why: Not shown by anything executed: Box<T> compiled without error in Lib (no MessagePack analyzer ran there), and the closed type Box<int> only exists in App.

story_claims.claim: This test checks the crash fix for unkeyed members.
story_claims.why: It passes only because of the global filter: with the filter reverted (crash fix kept) it fails with 2 MsgPack004 errors. It locks in the silence, not the fix.

not_checked: Runtime: whether the generated Box<int> formatter silently skips Unkeyed (data loss) or fails; we checked diagnostics only.
Other diagnostics the global filter can drop (any rule whose location is outside App's syntax trees); we executed one.
Non-generic referenced types: executed fact, the analyzer doesn't descend into them on base or head (EtScopeDriftReceiptsTests.Fact_ReferencedNonGenericType_MembersAreNotAnalyzed, placebo).
